notes: TMax is overwhelmingly the right pool here - it contains ~50 rdflib/SPARQL/Turtle tasks, several of which are near-perfect matches (fix a cross-join, write a .rq file, add GROUP BY + aggregate + LIMIT over an employees/departments graph). That is why 8 of my final 10 are TMax and I make no apology for it. RTS and TerminalWorld have essentially zero SPARQL: tw_582963 is the single RDF-query task in TerminalWorld and RTS has none at all, so for those two pools I fell back on the nearest real skill - authoring a declarative query (KSQL/GraphQL/SQL) as the graded artifact, and join-then-group-by aggregation over relational data. Those RTS/TW entries below rank 4 are honest filler. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench both reduce to the pypika/sqlparse SQL-query-construction cluster; pypika dominates my rebench list (7 of 10) because it is the only library in that corpus where the bug is 'the generated query is subtly wrong', which is the failure mode this task must avoid. One aspect of the TB task has no analogue anywhere: the date-validity filtering against a fixed reference date combined with an externally-known set (EU member states as of 2025-08-16).
